description: This PHP class 'PIMLeftMenuService' manages the left menu for the PIM module in OrangeHRM, including menu generation, caching, permission checks, and configuration handling.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuService
classes.description: Service class for managing the PIM module's left menu, including permission checks, caching, and menu item generation.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves menu items for a given employee, using cache if available.

methods.name: clearCachedMenu
methods.description: Clears cached menu data for a specific employee or all employees.

methods.name: isPimAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the PIM menu is accessible for a given employee.

methods.name: generateMenuItems
methods.description: Generates menu items based on permissions and employee state.

methods.name: isEmployeeWorkflowActionsAllowed
methods.description: Determines if workflow actions are allowed for an employee based on their state.

methods.name: getMenuFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves menu data from session cache.

methods.name: saveMenuInCache
methods.description: Stores menu data in session cache.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Returns available menu actions, filtering out tax exemptions if disabled.

methods.name: isTaxMenuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the tax menu is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getPreparedMenuItems
methods.description: Prepares menu items with URLs and active states for display.
